limitations: The statement excludes characteristic two, free rank two, nonlinear maps, and two-local derivations. An unindexed prior equivalent classification remains possible.
scientific_integrity: The proof is a complete self-contained classification in characteristic not two for free rank at least three. Exact finite-field checks independently corroborate selected ranks; they are not a proof for infinite parameter ranges. No priority or independence certification is claimed.
title: Local derivations of free two-step nilpotent Lie algebras
